newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Mercosur wants deal with Mexico similar to Chile.
newsitem.headline: Mercosur wants deal with Mexico similar to Chile.

text.p: The Mercosur trade bloc wants a similar free trade deal with Mexico as the one it signed with Chile, Paraguay's under-secretary of financial affairs, said Tuesday.

"We have decided to continue with the same format of negotiations that we had with Chile," Miguel Britos, Paraguay's under-secretary of financial affairs, told journalists, when asked about trade talks with Mexico.
Chile associated itself with the Mercosur bloc in January 1997 through a free trade agreement that includes a long list of goods that are excluded from the deal.

Leaders of the Mercosur bloc grouping Brazil, Argentina, Uruguay and Paraguay meet in Asuncion Wednesday and Thursday to discuss free trade in the whole Americas and possible link-ups with other regional groups such as the Andean nations and Asia's ASEAN trade bloc.
